texts.preamble: Yogesh Vijay Katale vs The State Of Maharashtra on 6 October, 2020 Author: V.K.Jadhav Bench: V.K.Jadhav {1} ba107620.odt In The High Court Of Judicature Of Bombay Bench At Aurangabad Bail Application No.1076 Of 2020 Yogesh Vijay Katale Applicant Versus The State of Maharashtra Respondent Mr.S.B.Rajebhosale, advocate for the applicant. Mr.D.R.Kale, Public Prosecutor for the Respondent. Coram : V.K.Jadhav, J. Date : 06th October, 2020.
texts.facts: The applicant is seeking bail in connection with Crime No.0431/2020, registered with MIDC Waluj Police Station, Aurangabad, for the ofences punishable under Sections 270, 273, 188, 328 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code. 2 Heard both sides. Upon search, it was found that the contraband article pan gutkha masala, costing {2} ba107620.odt about Rs.39,600/-, was being transported illegally.
texts.arguments: 3 The learned Counsel for the applicant submits that the Police Head Constable on duty, during patrolling, found one auto rickshaw proceeding in speed in suspicious manner and thus he chased the said auto rickshaw. The learned Counsel for the applicant submits that three co-accused persons, who were caught raid handed while transporting the said contraband article pan gutkha masala, came to be released on bail. However, one of the co-accused has disclosed the name of the applicant and it has been stated that they had Yogesh Vijay Katale vs The State Of Maharashtra on 6 October, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16981940/ 1 purchased the said contraband article pan gutkha masala from the present applicant. The learned Counsel submits that except the statement of the said co-accused person, which is not admissible in evidence, there is no connecting evidence against the applicant. The applicant has a fxed place of residing. The applicant is ready to abide by the conditions, if imposed by this Court, while releasing the applicant on bail. 4 The learned Public Prosecutor has strongly resisted the application on the ground that though the name of the applicant is disclosed by the co-accused person, however, investigation is still going on. The learned Public Prosecutor submits that there is criminal history. One crime under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, came to be registered against the applicant. The learned A.P.P., therefore, submits that the applicant may not be released on bail.
